name: Distant Leaps to Circinus
source:
A century has gone by since humanity nearly wiped all life from the earth. Their lust for power and progress tempted them to tamper with an unknown entity and, in turn, brought forth an enigma of change. The weather, animals, physics, and even humans had all taken new forms. What does "The Compass Planet", Circinus, offer to the children who are born upon its lands? What is the true nature of the "Second Sun"?

The lives of all living creatures are changed forever in an unforgiving world of rings. Enormous creatures roam the land, made up of the very life they were given. Crystals with entirely different elements bring functionality and mystery to the world. Landmasses that triumph the continents of the past world, float along an unknown axis, carrying the lives of millions with them. Children who can communicate in ways not known to anyone but them.

The story takes place a century after the first humans mysteriously awakened on the new world. The majority of the story follows young characters who have just started to truly explore their world. While they grow and learn, the vast amount of content is centered around their life and how they take on the challenges that arise.

[From [url=https://theunlighted.itch.io/distant-leaps-to-circinus]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一个世纪过去了，人类几乎消灭了地球上的所有生命。他们对权力和进步的渴望诱使他们去篡改一个未知的实体，反过来又带来了一个神秘的变化。天气、动物、物理，甚至人类都呈现出新的形态。“指南针星球”Circinus为出生在其土地上的孩子们提供了什么？“第二太阳”的真实本质是什么？

在无情的光环世界中，所有生物的生活都被永远改变。巨大的生物在这片土地上漫步，它们由赋予它们的生命组成。具有完全不同元素的水晶给世界带来功能性和神秘感。征服了过去世界的大陆的陆地沿着未知的轴线漂浮，承载着数百万人的生命。能够以除他们之外的任何人都不知道的方式进行交流的孩子。

故事发生在第一批人类在新世界神秘觉醒一个世纪后。故事的大部分内容都是围绕刚刚开始真正探索自己的世界的年轻角色展开的。在他们成长和学习的过程中，大量内容都围绕他们的生活以及他们如何应对出现的挑战。

[来自[url=https://theunlighted.itch.io/distant-leaps-to-circinus]itch.io[/url]]
